result.topic_en: Gauss parametrizes the half-sums and half-differences of the sides and angles of a spherical triangle by four quantities p, q, r, s with pp+qq+rr+ss=mm, tabulating their tangents, cosines and sines, and then does the same for angles and arcs in an auxiliary figure (point F, angle θ, CF=BF, PF=QF, GF, CFP, 2θ, AF).

methods.what: Parametrization of a spherical triangle by four quantities with sum of squares m^2
Tangents of half-sum/difference of angles and sides (Napier analogies form) in terms of p,q,r,s
Cosines and sines of half-angles and half-sides in terms of p,q,r,s,m
Equality of angles at auxiliary point F defining θ
Trigonometric values of θ and of arcs CF, PF, GF and angle CFP
Cosine and sine of arc AF
